answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. What survives to the horizon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A cipher of per-task receipts records who did what, and the yarrow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work.
